name: improv-frontend
description: IMPROV frontend — static web app, packaged for Android/iOS via Capacitor.

scripts.android:build: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npx cap sync ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator
